changes: Explicit --runtime validation and independent materialization into a disposable vendor layout; full payload SHA256/size inventory, pins, source locks, and cache checks.
Strict failure propagation and 535-second outer bounds; no implicit bootstrap/download path.
Fresh tracked working-tree snapshots exclude all project build artifacts; direct Lean project-only builds preserve package options and never schedule Mathlib compilation.
One-module and one-manifest interfaces; aggregate route manifests, duplicates/route validation, actual defining-module checks, strict axiom output allowlist.
Root and submodule forbidden-token scanning; explicit infrastructure-only empty mode; token scan is not a complete kernel audit.
Separate public pinned online preparation phases and updated usage/submission documentation.
network_isolation: Inherited Linux seccomp denies socket creation/use and io_uring; IPv4, IPv6, Unix and child-process probes return EPERM. No proxy-only claim. No HOME reassignment; allowlisted subprocess environment.
limitations: No theorem claims or proof/configuration/pin changes. Tests and runtimes are scratch only; source is about 60 KiB plus evidence logs.
Runtime and dependency caches are supplemental scratch artifacts, not submitted. Committed-only offline delivery is unavailable and remains UNVERIFIED.
Runtime manifest is an integrity inventory, not independent provenance authentication. Runtime/compiler/cache supplier must be trusted.
Evidence is self-checking by this worker, not an independent rebuild or theorem-fidelity review.
Token scanning is not a complete kernel audit.
failures_and_repairs:
Initial preparation failures, repaired before the passing runs:
1. curl -fL --max-time 55 -o test/scratch/harness/downloads/mathlib.tar.gz https://codeload.github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/tar.gz/fc4f59e577feb1a4956671bc04ac18aaaf8cd842 succeeded (0), but tar -xzf ... --strip-components=1 -C test/scratch/harness/runtime/src/mathlib failed (2): destination did not exist. Created it and extracted successfully (0).
2. First direct Cache get used a clean environment without transport settings: exit 1; curl exit 6, Could not resolve host: cache.mathlib.org; 9117 downloads failed. Explicit online preparation now forwards only proxy transport variables. Retry fetched/decompressed all 9117 artifacts (0). Offline forwards no such variables and seccomp denies sockets.
3. An exploratory rg of the toolchain source during extraction exited 2 (file not yet present); repeated after extraction succeeded.
4. The first full check could not resolve the project module root before any olean existed. The builder now creates output directories (never dummy oleans) before --deps.
5. TOML dotted keys originally became dictionary-valued -D arguments. Recursively flattening keys preserves the package's exact Lean options.
6. Lean.Name.mkStrList is absent at the pinned release. The origin check now uses String.toName. Genuine tests confirm correct/missing/wrong-module declarations.
7. Cache get initially autodetected the enclosing checkout's remote. Final preparation passes --repo=leanprover-community/mathlib4 and prevents parent-repository discovery; the exact command was separately tested, exit 0, Already decompressed 9117 files.
